title: Reading a shared finishing clock
abstract: Wall clocks on parallel benches distinguish the makespan of a batch from the completion time printed on a single ticket.

segments.source: We set the clock to zero when the batch opens. The completion time on a ticket records when that job leaves its bench. Only the last ticket to close determines the makespan of the batch.
segments.reference_zh: 批次开始时将时钟归零。工单上的完工时间记录对应作业离开工作台的时刻。只有最后结单的作业决定整个批次的最大完工时间。

segments.source: The makespan is at least <m1/>, the completion time on the blue ticket.
segments.reference_zh: 最大完工时间至少等于蓝色工单上的完工时间 <m1/>。

segments.source: Although the benches share a clock. Each bench stamps its own tickets.
segments.reference_zh: 虽然各工作台共用一台时钟，但工单由各工作台自行打上时间戳。

segments.source: If the blue ticket is blank, the auditor sets it aside for inspection.
segments.reference_zh: 蓝色工单若为空白，审核员就将其单独留存，以备检查。

anchors.description: 工单上的完工时间属于单个作业，批次的最大完工时间由最后结单的作业决定。
蓝色工单对应的 <m1/> 是批次最大完工时间的下界，允许相等。
共用时钟构成让步，各台自行打时间戳是同一编号内的主句。
空白是单独留存的条件，原条件句完整。

title: Choosing among eligible trays
abstract: A tray label gives the dispatcher a priority, while precedence constraints govern whether a tray may enter the press.

segments.source: In the press room, precedence constraints keep a coated tray out of the press until its coating has dried. A chalk mark gives the tray priority among those already dry enough to enter.
We assume that the drying interval exceeds <m1/> for the trial coating.
If the chalk washes off. The dispatcher still waits for the coating to dry.
Inspection of the exit tray takes priority over filing the cards at the end of the shift.

anchors.description: 涂层干燥是先后约束规定的准入条件，优先级仅参与合格托盘之间的选择。
干燥间隔严格大于 <m1/> 是对试验涂层的假设。
等待涂层干燥是标记被冲掉时仍须执行的动作。
此处 priority 指班末两项事务的轻重次序。

title: Reading a dial against a travel stop
abstract: A travel stop reveals a zero offset that would be invisible in a check of the scale factor alone.

segments.source: We bring the probe into contact with the stop and read the zero offset directly from the dial. To estimate the scale factor we then move the stop a known distance and divide the change in reading by that distance.
segments.reference_zh: 先让探头接触限位块，直接从表盘读出零点偏移。随后将限位块移动一段已知距离，用示值的变化量除以该距离，估计比例系数。

segments.source: The corrected reading is proportional to <m1/>, the displacement of the stop.
segments.reference_zh: 修正后的示值与限位块的位移 <m1/> 成正比。

segments.source: If the pointer sticks on the return sweep. The operator repeats the sweep from the stop.
segments.reference_zh: 若指针在回程中卡住，操作员便从限位块处重新进行回程扫描。

segments.source: The thin line marks 20% of full travel on the return scale.
segments.reference_zh: 细线标出回程刻度上全行程的 20%。

anchors.description: 起始示值给出零点偏移，示值变化与已知位移的比值估计比例系数。
与 <m1/> 成正比的是修正后的示值。
指针卡住是重新扫描的条件，起点在限位块处。
保留 20% 及仅标示回程的 <i> 标签。

title: Separating two sources of reading variation
abstract: Repeatability is measured on an undisturbed probe before reproducibility is assessed after transfer to another bench.

segments.source: Repeated touches with one probe on the same bench describe repeatability under fixed conditions. For reproducibility the second technician takes the block to a different bench and starts again with a separately mounted probe.
A change in technician does not imply that the reading difference must exceed <m1/>.
Although the block fits either mount. The second technician cleans the contact face before fastening it.
The log calls the contact face the seating face when describing the same polished surface.

anchors.description: 重复性对应同人同台的连续触测，再现性对应更换人员、工作台和探头安装。
否定的是读数差必定超过阈值 <m1/> 这一推论。
两种支架都适配并未免去第二位技术员的清洁步骤。
seating face 是同一抛光接触面的别称。

title: Arrivals at a counting window
abstract: A counting window separates the arrival rate measured over a long watch from the event count on one strip.

segments.source: We estimate the arrival rate by dividing all arrivals by the total time on watch. The event count on a single strip is the number observed during that strip alone, even when every strip has the same duration.
segments.reference_zh: 将全部到达次数除以总观测时长，即可估计到达率。单张记录条上的事件计数只统计该条记录时段内观察到的事件，即便各条记录的时长都相同。

segments.source: For strips of equal duration we assume that the event count follows the Poisson distribution specified by <m1/>.
segments.reference_zh: 对于时长相同的记录条，我们假设事件计数服从 <m1/> 所示的泊松分布。

segments.source: Although several strips contain no marks. Each strip contributes its full duration to the estimate.
segments.reference_zh: 虽然有些记录条上没有标记，但估计到达率时，每条记录的时长均须全额计入。

segments.source: The notes on strip alignment [3, 8] were written before the watch began.
segments.reference_zh: 有关记录条对齐的说明 [3, 8] 写于观测开始之前。

anchors.description: 到达率按时间折算，单条事件计数只统计该时段内的次数。
<m1/> 对应事件计数的泊松分布，服从该分布是一个假设。
无标记是让步条件，所有记录条都计入完整时长。
[3, 8] 对应对齐说明，时间在观测开始之前。

title: Variation across weighings of a sealed pan
abstract: A sealed pan illustrates the different units of sample variance and the standard error of a mean reading.

segments.source: The sample variance summarizes the spread of individual weighings in squared units of mass. To express uncertainty in the mean in the original units we report its standard error, treating the weighings as independent.
Under equal variances the standard error of the mean decreases in proportion to <m1/> as independent weighings accumulate.
If a weight is removed before the pointer settles. The operator discards that reading.
A second pan remains sealed during weighing and serves solely as a handling check. We denote its reading by <m1/>.

anchors.description: 样本方差用质量单位的平方表示，均值的标准误用原质量单位表示，并以独立为前提。
独立、等方差时均值标准误随 <m1/> 成比例减小。
弃掉的是未待指针稳定便移去砝码的那一次读数。
第二只盘保持密封，仅用于检查操作过程。 <m1/> 仅命名其读数。

title: Two sides of a memory mapping
abstract: A virtual page can retain its address after its page frame has been assigned to another task.

segments.source: A virtual page belongs to the address space of the task. Its page frame is a slot in physical memory, so the task can retain the address of a page even while that slot holds other data.
segments.reference_zh: 虚拟页属于任务的地址空间。承载它的页框是物理内存中的一个存储单元，因此，即使该单元已存放其他数据，任务仍可保有这个页的地址。

segments.source: The number of occupied frames cannot exceed <m1/>, the size of the physical pool measured in frames.
segments.reference_zh: 已占用的页框数不能超过物理页框池的容量 <m1/>，该容量以页框为单位。

segments.source: Although a task releases its frame. The ledger preserves the old page address for the audit.
segments.reference_zh: 尽管任务释放了页框，台账仍保留原页地址供审计。

segments.source: A page table entry (PTE) records the mapping. The audit uses the PTE copied at dispatch.
segments.reference_zh: 页表项（PTE）记录映射关系。审计使用的是调度时复制的 PTE。

anchors.description: 虚拟页位于任务地址空间，页框位于物理内存；页地址可以在页框改作他用后保留。
<m1/> 绑定物理池容量，约束的对象是占用的页框数。
台账为审计保留原页地址，释放页框的是任务。
PTE 是 page table entry 的缩写，审计使用调度时的副本。

title: Admission to a fixed message buffer
abstract: A ledger distinguishes queue depth from queue capacity at the instant a message is offered.

segments.source: On receipt of a message the clerk samples queue depth by counting messages already in the buffer. Queue capacity is set when the buffer is allocated and stays fixed as later messages enter and leave.
The trace labels the depth sample <m1/> and the allocation limit <m2/>. A full buffer has depth equal to the allocation limit.
If two offers reach the buffer together. The clerk processes the one from the older connection first.
The header says message buffer and the margin says holding queue for the same store.

anchors.description: 队列深度是现存消息数，队列容量由分配时设定。
两个占位符分别标示采样深度和分配上限；只有满缓冲区才断言两者相等，未给出分布。
较早建立的连接只在同时到达时优先。
用户指定 message buffer 与 holding queue 均译为“消息缓冲区”。
